analysis: Ornithine transcarbamylase (OTC) deficiency is known to cause both hyperammonemia and orotic aciduria. Other enzyme deficiencies in the urea cycle, such as arginase, arginine succinate synthase, and carbamoyl phosphate synthetase, do not typically cause orotic aciduria.
